decision.summary: The Federal Reserve kept its target interest rate at 0 to 1/4 percent and continued its ongoing asset purchase programs.

changes.quote: Information received since the Federal Open Market Committee met in December suggests that growth in economic activity paused in recent months, in large part because of weather-related disruptions and other transitory factors.
changes.explanation: The Fed noted that economic growth temporarily paused recently, largely due to weather and other short-term factors.

changes.quote: Employment has continued to expand at a moderate pace but the unemployment rate remains elevated.
changes.explanation: The Fed observed that job gains continue at a moderate pace, but total unemployment is still high.

changes.quote: Household spending and business fixed investment advanced, and the housing sector has shown further improvement.
changes.explanation: Consumer spending, business investment, and the housing market all showed continued signs of improvement.

changes.quote: Although strains in global financial markets have eased somewhat, the Committee continues to see downside risks to the economic outlook.
changes.explanation: Even though global market stress has reduced, the Fed still sees risks that could slow down the economy.

tone_quotes.quote: Information received since the Federal Open Market Committee met in December suggests that growth in economic activity paused in recent months, in large part because of weather-related disruptions and other transitory factors.

To support a stronger economic recovery and to help ensure that inflation, over time, is at the rate most consistent with its dual mandate, the Committee will continue purchasing additional agency mortgage-backed securities at a pace of $40 billion per month and longer-term Treasury securities at a pace of $45 billion per month.

for_you.text: Card rates should not move on this decision; a $5,000 balance at about 11.95% APR costs about $49.79 a month in interest.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury yield, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 2.03% and moved 0 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 3.38% would not change.
Savings yields should stay roughly where they are, since the Fed held rates.
Unemployment was 7.9%, and employers added an average of 186k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 1.8% over the past year (December 2012); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 1.7%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 0.5% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved -3 bp on the day.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved -0.06% on the day.

whats_next: The statement signals that the Federal Reserve will maintain its ultra-low interest rates and continue buying assets until the labor market improves substantially. According to the educational forecast model, there is an 87 percent chance of a hold at the next meeting, an 11 percent chance of a cut, and a 2 percent chance of a hike.

citations.detail: In particular, the Committee decided to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent
